plugin_desc: Gude PDU SNMP child template for network-service devices under Gude PEN 28507. Interface traffic is supplied by the shared NetworkService SNMP IF-MIB floor rather than a plugin-side ifHC expansion. The primary live metering subtree is GUDEADS-PDU8310-MIB (28507.27), selected by sysObjectID gadsPDU8310 and a responding pdu8310PowerTable. Proven private increments are pdu8310PowerActive as pdu_active_power_watts, pdu8310Current as pdu_channel_current_amps scaled by /1000 from milliamperes to amperes, and optional pdu8310Voltage as pdu_channel_voltage_volts from the same parent table. Old EPC8 devices without metering fall back to epc8PortState as pdu_outlet_power_state (0=off/1=on, state only, no current). CPU and memory scalars are not invented. Other GUDEADS product branches such as 28507.64 are not mix-bound in this child. Supported brands/models - Gude PDU8310 metering devices under PEN 28507.27, with EPC8 port-state fallback under PEN 28507.1, plus standard IF-MIB.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: pdu_active_power_watts
metrics.description: Per-channel active power in Watts from pdu8310PowerActive (1.3.6.1.4.1.28507.27.1.5.1.2.1.4) with pdu8310PowerIndex (1.3.6.1.4.1.28507.27.1.5.1.2.1.1). The SNMP value is already in Watts.

metrics.name: pdu_channel_current_amps
metrics.description: Per-channel current in amperes from pdu8310Current (1.3.6.1.4.1.28507.27.1.5.1.2.1.5) with pdu8310PowerIndex (1.3.6.1.4.1.28507.27.1.5.1.2.1.1). The SNMP value is milliamperes, so the query divides by 1000.

metrics.name: pdu_channel_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Per-channel voltage in volts from pdu8310Voltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.28507.27.1.5.1.2.1.6) on the same pdu8310PowerTable parent as pdu8310Current. The SNMP value is already in volts.

metrics.name: pdu_outlet_power_state
metrics.description: Per-outlet power switch state from epc8PortState (1.3.6.1.4.1.28507.1.1.2.2.1.3) with epc8PortIndex and epc8PortName. This is the fallback for old EPC8 devices without metering. Value 0 is off and 1 is on. Current is not collected on this path.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
